## Historical Trials {#sec-historical-km}

Kaplan-Meier curves for the historical trials (excluding SCLC) used to inform the hierarchical model.

```{r}
#| label: fig-kaplan-meier-historical
#| fig-cap: Kaplan-Meier plots for the historical trials. The full forecasting row predicts PFS beyond the observed right censoring while the observed censoring row censors predictions that exceed the observed right censoring.
#| column: body-outset
#| fig-width: 7

plot_km(
  tar_read(all_tumor_ssls_km_rvar_ctdna_jan26) |> filter(!fct_match(trial, "sclc")),
  km_est_var = sample_km_est,
  obs_km_data = tar_read(km_trial_pfs_ctdna_jan26) |>
    filter(fct_match(btype, "ub"), !fct_match(trial, "sclc")) |>
    select(!quantiles) |>
    unnest(km_data),
  analysis_data = all_analysis_data |> filter(!fct_match(trial, "sclc")),
  facet_col = trial
)
```

## SCLC Forecasts {#sec-sclc-km}

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Sample-Based

Kaplan-Meier curves for the SCLC trial, comparing model predictions with observed data. The full forecasting row predicts PFS beyond the observed right censoring while the observed censoring row censors predictions that exceed the observed right censoring.

```{r}
#| label: fig-kaplan-meier-sclc-forecast
#| fig-cap: Sample-based Kaplan-Meier forecast for SCLC trial.
#| fig-width: 7

plot_sclc_km_by_estimate_type("sample")
```

### Superpopulation

Kaplan-Meier curves for the SCLC trial, comparing model predictions with observed data. The full forecasting row predicts PFS beyond the observed right censoring while the observed censoring row censors predictions that exceed the observed right censoring.

```{r}
#| label: fig-kaplan-meier-sclc-superpopulation
#| fig-cap: Superpopulation Kaplan-Meier forecast for SCLC trial. Superpopulation KM estimates represent the expected survival for the underlying population, not just the specific patients in the trial.
#| fig-width: 7

plot_sclc_km_by_estimate_type("spop")
```

:::
